passage: Last Saturday, I woke up early and decided to clean our apartment. The rooms looked messy after a busy week. I opened all the windows first, and fresh air moved through the rooms. I washed the dishes in the kitchen and wiped the table. Then I swept the floor in the living room and the bedroom. The dust covered everything, so I worked with care. My wife joined me at ten. She folded the clothes and sorted the old newspapers. We threw away the broken boxes and moved the sofa to a new corner. It changed the whole room. After we finished, I mopped the floor with warm water. The apartment smelled clean and fresh. At noon, we ordered some noodles and rested on the sofa. My wife said it looked like a new home. I felt tired but happy.

We threw away the broken boxes and moved the sofa to a new corner.
